$comment: License policy for scripts/license-check.mjs. Every installed package (prod + dev) must have a license expression satisfied by `allow`, must not match `deny`, and must not be in `denyPackages`. `exceptions` are keyed by package name (a trailing * matches a name prefix) and pinned to the exact license string reported: if that package's license ever changes, CI fails and the exception needs re-review. The root package (private, UNLICENSED) is excluded.

denyPackages.@metamask/sdk: MetaMask SDK terms: proprietary, non-commercial or <10k MAU, non-transferable (Odin buyout-readiness scan 2026-10-08). Was pulled in only by the unused @x402/paywall.
denyPackages.@x402/paywall: Unused browser paywall UI; pulls in @metamask/sdk and WalletConnect (custom LICENSE.md terms). Removed 2026-10-08. @x402/core serves its built-in fallback 402 HTML without it.

exceptions.reason: Browser-support data table, CC-BY-4.0 = attribution only, not copyleft, no use restriction. Attribution carried in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.

exceptions.scope: prod, optional, platform-specific (via next -> sharp): prebuilt libvips for linux-x64 / linuxmusl-x64 / darwin / arm64
exceptions.reason: Unmodified prebuilt libvips shared library, dynamically loaded by sharp for Next.js image optimization. LGPL (weak copyleft), not GPL/AGPL; we do not modify or statically link it. Notice + upstream source link (github.com/lovell/sharp-libvips) in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES. Flag for counsel review in the buyout data room; not a blocker.

exceptions.scope: optional, platform-specific (via next -> sharp): WebAssembly build of sharp + libvips; installed by npm as an optional dep, only used where no native binary exists
exceptions.reason: Same libvips LGPL component as @img/sharp-libvips-*, compiled to wasm, unmodified. Same treatment and counsel flag.
SPDX exception-list data, attribution only, dev tooling, not shipped.
SPDX range data, attribution only, dev tooling, not shipped.
